clauses.reason: Terminated by Executive Order 12553, signed February 25, 1986 and published at 51 FR 7237 in the Federal Register of March 3, 1986. Its enacting sentence orders that the listed Executive Orders, and "any amendments thereto", are revoked; the text states no delayed effective date and contains no saving clause, so the effective date is the signing date, 1986-02-25 (the printed date, March 3, 1986, is the alternative reading). The table of revoked orders in the held text of Executive Order 12553 lists number 11805 in the number column of the table (the text layer separates the number column from the subject column for this part of the table, so its subject text is not quoted). This order (39 FR 34261, Federal Register of September 24, 1974, signed September 20, 1974) orders that any return defined in section 301.6103(a)-1 of the Treasury Regulations on Procedure and Administration (26 CFR Part 301), as amended from time to time, made in respect of any tax described in section 301.6103(a)-1(a)(2), shall be delivered to or open to inspection by the President only upon a written request signed by the President personally; prescribes the contents of the request (the name and address of the taxpayer, the kind of return and the taxable period), addressed to the Secretary of the Treasury or his delegate; allows the President to designate by name employees of the White House Office holding a Presidential commission with an annual rate of basic pay at or above that prescribed by 5 U.S.C. 5316; bars disclosure by such an employee except to the President without the President's written direction; and subjects all persons obtaining access to the return to 26 U.S.C. 6103, as amended. It states no end date.

research_rationale:
Identity: the held Federal Register text (39 FR 34261, the issue of September 24, 1974) is Executive Order 11805, dated September 20, 1974; the order is headed Executive Order 11805, Inspection by President and Certain Designated Employees of the White House Office of Tax Returns Made Under the Internal Revenue Code of 1954, and is dated September 20, 1974. I read the whole order; the representation is the machine-extracted text layer of the official PDF (OCR for this period), and I did not inspect the page images. End: express revocation by Executive Order 12553 on 1986-02-25. Searches: current-law:usc, current-law:ecfr and later-events:ofr_catalog, each marked complete in the dossier. The two machine hits of the U.S. Code search for this number are Federal Register page citations (41 F.R. 11805) in notes to another order, not references to this order.
